title: Engine names: suffix <name>-<worktree> replaces wt: prefix
description: internal/tiltfile/worktree: boundary.go/prefix.go/display.go — clone manifest name form becomes <name>-<worktree> (suffix; authored name leads; '-' is apiserver-name-safe for owned objects).
